answer: I'm sorry for your loss. To sell a car you inherited, bring your father's death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, either the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1, and a power of attorney your father signed can't be used because it ended when he died. If there's still a loan on the car, the lender holds the title, and if it's paid off but the title is lost, you'll need a duplicate title from your state before we can complete the purchase.
